moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The UK is gearing up for the August Bank Holiday weekend, marking the unofficial end of summer for many in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Travel
angles.copy: Bank Holiday getaway chaos or smooth sailing? Wherever you're heading this long weekend, we've got the soundtrack. What are your travel plans?

angles.name: Last Taste of Summer
angles.copy: Squeezing every last drop out of summer! The August Bank Holiday is almost here, bringing with it one more chance for BBQs, beach trips, or just chilling out. How are you celebrating?

moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off Matchweek 2
moments.blurb: The Premier League 2026/27 season is in full swing, with Matchweek 1 concluding tonight and Matchweek 2 fixtures starting this Friday, including Fulham vs Chelsea today.

angles.name: Tonight's Match
angles.copy: Premier League action tonight! Fulham take on Chelsea in the final game of Matchweek 1. Who are you backing to grab the points?

angles.name: Weekend Ahead
angles.copy: Get ready for more Premier League drama! Matchweek 2 kicks off this Friday, with big clashes all weekend. Who's your team playing, and are you feeling confident?

moments.title: Live From Wythenshawe Park Continues
moments.blurb: Manchester's Live From Wythenshawe Park summer concert series continues this week with headline sets from Pulp (August 28), Courteeners (August 29), and The Prodigy (August 30).

angles.name: Manchester's Big Weekend
angles.copy: Manchester, get ready! Pulp, Courteeners, and The Prodigy are all set to rock Wythenshawe Park this Bank Holiday weekend. Which gig are you buzzing for?

angles.name: Pulp Fiction Live
angles.copy: Common People of Manchester, Pulp are headlining Wythenshawe Park this Friday! Expect a legendary night of indie anthems. Who's in?

moments.title: Ariana Grande at The O2 London
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Ariana Grande is performing at The O2 Arena in London tonight, August 24th, as part of her highly anticipated tour.

angles.name: Ariana Takes London
angles.copy: London, get ready for an 'Eternal Sunshine' night! Ariana Grande is at The O2 tonight. If you're going, have the best time!

angles.name: Pop Royalty
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is bringing her incredible vocals and stage presence to The O2 tonight. What's your favourite Ariana track?

moments.title: Big Gigs in Glasgow This Week
moments.blurb: Glasgow hosts a busy week of live music, featuring Geese at Barrowland Ballroom (August 26), McFly at Queen's Park (August 27), The Waterboys at OVO Hydro (August 29), and Scissor Sisters at Queen's Park (August 30).

angles.name: Glasgow's Live Music Hub
angles.copy: Glasgow's music scene is buzzing! From Geese to McFly, The Waterboys to Scissor Sisters, there's a huge variety of gigs this week. Which one are you heading to?

angles.name: McFly in the Park
angles.copy: Calling all McFly fans! They're hitting Queen's Park in Glasgow on Thursday. Get ready to sing along to all the hits!

moments.title: Exeter Guildhall Live Festival
moments.blurb: Guildhall Shopping Exeter celebrates its 50th birthday with Guildhall Live, a free three-day music festival in Market Square from August 29-31, featuring tribute acts and local talent.

angles.name: Free Exeter Music
angles.copy: Exeter! Get ready for a FREE Bank Holiday weekend of live music at Guildhall Live, celebrating 50 years of Guildhall Shopping Exeter. Who's coming?

angles.name: Bank Holiday Beats
angles.copy: Looking for Bank Holiday plans in Exeter? Guildhall Live has three days of free music, tributes, and local acts from Saturday. Perfect for all the family!

moments.title: Faye Webster Live in Cardiff
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Faye Webster is performing in Cardiff tonight, August 24th, bringing her unique blend of indie and R&B to Welsh fans.

angles.name: Cardiff's Indie Night
angles.copy: Faye Webster is in Cardiff tonight! If you're heading out to see her, prepare for some seriously smooth indie tunes. Enjoy the show!

angles.name: Live in Wales
angles.copy: Welsh fans, Faye Webster is bringing her captivating sound to Cardiff tonight! What's your top track to hear live?

moments.title: Latest UK Official Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The UK Official Singles Chart is fresh with new entries and big movers, including tracks from Sam Fender & Olivia Dean, Katseye, Phoebe Bridgers, and Olivia Rodrigo.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Who's ruling the Official Singles Chart this week? Sam Fender and Olivia Dean are still up there, but new entries from Katseye and Phoebe Bridgers are making waves! What's your current #1?

angles.name: New Music Alert
angles.copy: Fresh tracks hitting the charts! Keep an ear out for Katseye and Phoebe Bridgers making their mark. Any new favourites for you?

moments.title: Gene Simmons Turns 77
moments.blurb: KISS co-founder, bassist, and rock icon Gene Simmons celebrates his 77th birthday tomorrow, August 25th, 2026.

angles.name: Rock Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the Demon turns 77! Happy Birthday to KISS legend Gene Simmons. What's your favourite KISS track or Gene moment?

angles.name: KISS Icon
angles.copy: 77 years young! Gene Simmons, the iconic bassist from KISS, celebrates his birthday tomorrow. Let's blast some KISS loud!

moments.title: Shirley Manson Turns 60
moments.blurb: Garbage frontwoman and alternative rock icon Shirley Manson celebrates her 60th birthday on Wednesday, August 26th, 2026.

angles.name: Garbage Queen Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 60th Birthday to the incredible Shirley Manson of Garbage this Wednesday! Still looking and sounding absolutely iconic. What's your go-to Garbage song?

angles.name: Alt-Rock Icon
angles.copy: From 'Stupid Girl' to 'Only Happy When It Rains', Shirley Manson has given us so many anthems. Wishing her a very happy 60th on Wednesday!

moments.title: Florence Welch Turns 40
moments.blurb: Florence + The Machine lead singer Florence Welch celebrates her 40th birthday on Thursday, August 28th, 2026.

angles.name: Florence's Big 4-0
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the wonderfully enchanting Florence Welch this Thursday! Her voice is pure magic. What's your favourite Florence + The Machine song?

angles.name: Queen of Indie Pop
angles.copy: From 'Dog Days Are Over' to 'Shake It Out', Florence Welch has given us so many incredible tracks. Wishing her a fantastic 40th on Thursday!

moments.title: Liam Payne Turns 33
moments.blurb: Former One Direction member and solo artist Liam Payne celebrates his 33rd birthday on Friday, August 29th, 2026.

angles.name: 1D Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 33rd Birthday to Liam Payne this Friday! From One Direction to his solo hits, he's given us plenty of bangers. What's your favourite Liam track?

angles.name: Pop Prince Turns 33
angles.copy: He's turning 33! Wishing a very happy birthday to Liam Payne on Friday. Time to blast some 1D throwbacks!

moments.title: Van Morrison Turns 81
moments.blurb: Iconic Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison celebrates his 81st birthday on Monday, August 31st, 2026.

angles.name: Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: The legendary Van Morrison turns 81 this Bank Holiday Monday! From 'Brown Eyed Girl' to 'Moondance', his catalogue is timeless. What's your favourite Van the Man song?

angles.name: Celebrating Van the Man
angles.copy: 81 years of pure musical genius! Happy Birthday to Van Morrison on Monday. Perfect excuse for a weekend soundtrack filled with his classics.

moments.title: Gloria Estefan Turns 69
moments.blurb: Cuban-American pop superstar Gloria Estefan celebrates her 69th birthday on Tuesday, September 1st, 2026.

angles.name: Conga Queen Birthday
angles.copy: Get On Your Feet and celebrate! The incredible Gloria Estefan turns 69 this Tuesday. What's your favourite Miami Sound Machine hit?

angles.name: Pop Icon Turns 69
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 69th birthday to the one and only Gloria Estefan on Tuesday! Her music still makes us want to 'Rhythm of the Night'.
